programs.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programs.desc: It's a close call as Customs makes a big discovery inside a phone book. A box of socks sparks everyone's worst fear. And a passenger learns his fate after trying to fool our border security.

programs.title: Border Security - Australia's Front Line
programs.desc: Immigration officials are suspicious of a man as he comes through the primary line. A University accounting student from China is found with various undeclared cash bundles in her luggage.  She is referred to Australian Federal Police and she is fined AUD$1,000 for failing to declare currency over AUD$10,000.

programs.title: Border Security: America's Front Line
programs.desc: A returning American is cuffed at the Peace Arch crossing in Washington and in Detroit, a German rock band rolls straight into secondary.

programs.title: Ax Men
programs.desc: The season is halfway through, and the gap between winners and losers is widening. Stump Branch tests a new but more dangerous logging strategy… and it poses great danger to the men in the rigging. The Pihl men play while the bosses are away. Browning Logging is a team divided. Jesse struggles to prove himself to his father… but faulty equipment isn’t helping matters. A mistake on the Gustafson crew may end one man’s career.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
